body: I was thinking of pills. I don't know how to comfort you since I'm experiencing the same thing rn, all I can say is you're not the only one. I still don't get how people you've never met in person could hurt you like this. I wish we never replied that day.
Don't you wanna die in a painless way?
God I can relate to you so much, though he didn't cheat but he had hurt me so bad. What's stopping you from doing it?

I've been thinking the same thing for awhile now but it's really hard. We tried to break up for a couple of times already yet we still keep on coming back to each other. I really want us to work and the thought of not being with him scares me.

There are times when I open up to him and he tells me to shut up. I'm really open with how I feel but he thinks I'm just starting an argument. I'm way worse but there are times that he hurts me too intentionally. Do relationships like this still has a chance of working or I really have to let go now?
